# GlyphLock LLC

GlyphLock LLC is an Arizona limited liability company founded on May 24, 2025, in El Mirage, Arizona. GlyphLock develops evidence infrastructure for identity, permission, secure QR, venue operations, financial accountability, APIs, hardware-assisted workflows, and governance.

## NUPS

NUPS means Nexus Unified Portal System. It is venue-operations software that connects identity, role, contract, shift, register, payout, reconciliation, and audit records. NUPS can package references from payment and hospitality systems, but those source systems remain authoritative for the events they control.

These identifiers document enrollment and development activity. Oracle Cloud Marketplace program enrollment 1655445 is approved and active. A published NUPS Marketplace listing, production OPERA Cloud access, and Simphony Solution Validation or certification are not approved as of September 3, 2026; the formal Simphony integration request submitted August 25 remains under Oracle review.
